quotes.text:
Apple’s behaviour killed many extensions. I use [Bloquealos](https://apps.apple.com/it/app/bloquealos/id1554895615) on iOS and the rare times i use Safari on Mac, but I recommend you to try Firefox on Desktop. It’s not as efficient as Safari but it doesn’t eat your battery like chrome and with the right extensions the overall user experience gets perfect. I can’t imagine abandoning all the extensions now that i’m used to. 
Also container (enhanced -again- with extensions) are revolutionary.
